description: The plot illustrates the performance of different document sources with varying chunking sizes. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens", has a linear scale, ranges from 200 to 800, and has tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 40, and has tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different document source: Tutorials (blue, circle marker, solid line), Library Documentation (orange, circle marker, solid line), StackOverflow posts (green, circle marker, solid line), and Github files (red, circle marker, solid line). The blue line starts at around 6.5 and increases to approximately 28, the orange line starts at around 17.5 and increases to about 29, the green line starts at around 28 and increases to approximately 33.5, and the red line starts at around 3.5 and increases to about 30.5. All lines exhibit an upward trend across the x-axis, with the green line having the highest value at 800 tokens.
